Quantanium — R&R HUR-L4 → Levski.risk: Medium — piracy risk en route to Levski
Quantanium — R&R HUR-L4 → Levski.notes: Best single-trade-run profit in Stanton. Quantanium decays — refine or sell within ~25 min of mining.

Quantanium — R&R HUR-L4 → Lorville.notes: Shorter route than Levski. Slightly lower price but safer and faster turnaround.

Diamond — R&R ARC-L2 → New Babbage.notes: Solid mid-tier route with decent margins. Diamond is stable — no decay or illegal cargo risk.

Bexalite — R&R ARC-L1 → New Babbage.notes: Good mid-tier route. Available at multiple ArcCorp lagrange outposts. Consistent pricing.

Agricium — R&R CRU-L5 → Lorville.notes: Reliable route for medium haulers. Crusader space → Hurston. Low risk corridor.

Taranite — R&R HUR-L3 → Area18.notes: Good tonnage route. Hurston belt to ArcCorp. Watch for pirates between planets.

Laranite — R&R HUR-L4 → Levski.notes: Good for large haulers (C2, Hull C). Stable commodity — no decay risk.

Stims — R&R HUR-L5 → Grim HEX.notes: Low margin but safe and easy. Good for starter ships with small cargo. Grim HEX always buys.

Medical Supplies — New Babbage → Levski.notes: Low margin but consistent. Pair with other goods on the return trip to maximise efficiency.

Agricultural Supplies — Lorville → R&R A.notes: Very low margin but great for filling empty cargo holds. Lorville is the cheapest source.

Copper — Lorville → Area18.notes: Decent low-end metal run. Consistent and reliable. Good for smaller ships.

Gold — Lorville → Area18.notes: Solid mid-value metal. Easy route between Hurston and ArcCorp. Low risk compared to Quant.

Titanium — Lorville → Area18.notes: Reliable low-margin metal run. Good for larger cargo capacities to make it worthwhile.

Tungsten — R&R HUR-L2 → Port Tressler.notes: Long route but steady. Hurston belt → microTech. Pair with return cargo for back-haul efficiency.

Scrap — Port Tressler → Lorville.notes: Salvage scrap route. Works best with a large hauler. Low margin but near-zero investment.

Diluthermex — Orison → Levski.notes: Small margin filler. Good for empty cargo holds on Crusader → Delamar runs.

Beryl — R&R CRU-L3 → Area18.notes: Low-risk, low-reward route. Good for newer traders learning the ropes.

Corundum — R&R CRU-L5 → Lorville.notes: Low margin mineral run. Good for filling holds on Crusader → Hurston routes.
